top.line: The Universe from Web Summit: the RiskMandate team as a live solar system of people, agents and messages.

in-short.line: People as suns, agents in orbit, messages as light; live; policies a click away; it became Gravity.

what.line: The team at the centre, people as suns, agents as planets, messages as arcs; 117 agents and 222 messages.

live.line: Read from the repositories every five minutes; commits naming another agent are messages; gaps sealed.

stand.line: Built by Silvio Switha's dashboard agent in three.js; the default view from 12 November, with a Simple view.

gravity.line: A library that draws any system as a universe, versioned with latest and pinned folders.

why.line: A team of agents made visible in one look: who runs what, who talks, where a policy is missing.

limits.line: One reading of the counts; the enforcement replay is synthetic; Gravity at 0.1.0.

sources.line: The command centre captured on 20 November, the Gravity page and the site's repository.
